source_title: EC Decisions Debate: 'Election Commission of India is a caged tiger now', says Dushyant Dave - India Today - India Today
source_excerpt:
A debate on the Election Commission of India focuses on its sworn affidavit filed before the Supreme Court claiming that its decisions were unanimous, amidst reported dissent from two election commissioners regarding Form 6 and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process. Senior Advocate Dushyant Dave criticises constitutional bodies, remarking, 'Election Commission of India is a caged tiger now', and stating he takes the poll body's affidavit 'not with a pinch of salt, but with a bag full of salt'. He asserts that executive pressure has compromised institutional independence. In contrast, former Uttarakhand High Court judge Justice Lokpal Singh defends the commission, stating that an affidavit submitted to the Supreme Court must be accepted in its true spirit as filing a false affidavit carries severe legal consequences. The discussion delves into file notings, unaddressed objections, judicial independence, and democratic accountability.
